title: Watch Face AAPSv2 Missing IOB and 10min BG Delta
symptom: Watch face AAPSv2 is missing IOB and 10-minute BG delta information. The issue also seems to impact other watch faces. The problem has persisted for a few weeks.
cause: The user did not have the 'show delta' and 'show IOB' settings turned on.
fix: Turn on the 'show delta' and 'show IOB' settings.
evidence_quote: Found that I didn't have the show delta & show IOB settings turned on 😢 All working fine.
